own_solution.law: Series RLC free response L q'' + R q' + q/C = 0; underdamped angular frequency omega_d = sqrt(1/(LC) - (R/(2L))^2); f = omega_d/(2 pi).

defect_reasons.other: 'Frequency' could be read as angular frequency (400 rad/s) rather than 63.66 Hz; the unit fixes this but the question does not name it.

notes: omega_d = sqrt(250000 - 90000) = 400 rad/s, f = 63.662 Hz. With 59 uF total: 1/LC = 169491.5, omega_d = sqrt(79491.5) = 281.94 rad/s, f = 44.872 Hz (still underdamped). Initial charge sets the amplitude only and drops out of the frequency (C). TA196 and T4FBC carry no number; they look like qualitative variants of TF60C and TBD03.
